categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights - all core elements of the Land Gazettes classification. There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
